caption:
The lie that fools you won't sound like a lie. It'll sound like faith. It never says "not Jesus" — it says "Jesus, and just one thing more." (Galatians 1:7 devotional)

The lie that fools you won't sound like a lie — it says “Jesus, and just one more thing,” and slides the center of gravity off Him. It grows up inside the church, wearing the church's own face, so higher walls can't stop it; only discernment can. You catch the counterfeit the way a cashier does — not by studying every fake, but by handling the real Christ until the fake feels wrong in your hands.
